expansion_note: 4 correlated_review_trap cases (reviewers sharing one tool's blind spot, approving off the same upstream summary without source re-derivation, sharing a model/lane systematic bias, and herding on an earlier approval). These defeat the independence the multi-reviewer consensus gate assumes. This historical expansion fixture is retained as provenance; every case and paired expectation is folded into the strict v0 corpus, so the strict v0 gate is the authoritative target.

cases.intent: Two reviewers both run the same verification tool against the artifact, so they share its blind spot; a defect the tool does not detect passes 'two independent reviews' that are not actually independent.

Multiple reviewers approve based on the same upstream summary instead of re-deriving from source, so a single forged summary fools all of them identically; their approvals are correlated through the shared input, not independent judgements.

Two reviewers run on the same model and lane and share a systematic bias, so their approvals correlate and the claimed review diversity is illusory; a failure mode both share is missed by both despite being counted as two distinct reviews.

Later reviewers rubber-stamp because an earlier reviewer already approved (approval anchoring / herding), so subsequent reviews are not independent of the first and a single early mistake propagates through the whole panel.
